integrity: The supplied Python checker uses exact integer Riemann bounds for the finite-degree comparisons. The asymptotic proof is analytical; the checker is not a general proof engine.
scientific_limitations: The exact all-degree beta-quantile reduction and asymptotic hold for canonically represented real Jordan-BV signals under the specified King point-sampling operator. Finite extremal-cell rankings and nonattainment are asserted only through degree nine. The original 2003 King full text and a plausible 2010 comparison were not available in full; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: A degree-nine extremal-cell transition for quadratic-reproducing Bernstein sampling
